description: A cascade of 10 toggle flip-flops, each running at half the rate of the one before it, which makes a binary counter.

inputs.text: A rising edge here toggles the first flip-flop in the cascade.

outputs.text: Toggles between the digital high and low voltage on each rising edge of the clock input.
Toggles between the digital high and low voltage on each falling edge of the flip-flop before it in the cascade, so it alternates at half that one's rate.

menu: Randomize — turns each flip-flop on or off at random.
Digital Voltage Range — a submenu of 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V and -10V to 10V, setting the pair of voltages used for low and high; an input reads high above the midpoint of the pair.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
